Author: CrownedPandaXIV
Name: XIV Fleet Companion
Description:
Got a massive fleet of submarines? Always struggling to see which ones need upgrades? Wanna see your multi-account fleet at a glance? Give this a try!

This plugin sends your fleet to the free XIV Fleet Companion app for Windows, which shows it all in one window. Get the app from https://github.com/CrownedPandaXIV/XIVFleetCompanion-Releases

Needs:
• AutoRetainer (from https://love.puni.sh/ment.json)

Works best with:
• Allagan Tools: bags, retainers' items and FC chests
• FC Tracker (from https://puni.sh/api/repository/erdelf): FC houses
• Submarine Tracker: voyage loot

Thanks to kawaii, NightmareXIV and the Puni.sh team (AutoRetainer), Critical_Impact (Allagan Tools), erdelf (FC Tracker) and Infi (Submarine Tracker) for their plugins.
Punchline: Here to help manage your EMPIAH!
Changelog:
Goes with app 1.6.0, which adds the table this uses to the database by itself. With an older app, the plugin syncs as before.

- Only the setup a character last logged in on syncs it. Each setup (PC and account label) notes in the database when a character logs in on it. A setup then leaves alone any character that last logged in on another setup, so an old copy of that character left in its AutoRetainer can't overwrite the real one any more. Nobody has to tidy AutoRetainer for this. A character that hasn't logged in anywhere since the update keeps syncing as before, and there's no time limit: after a long break, each character still belongs to the setup it last logged in on. Changing a setup's account label takes its characters along. A character unticked in a setup's settings never counts as that setup's, and unticking one gives up the claim, so unticking a character on one PC (say, a laptop) never stops another PC that syncs it. The plugin's window says how many characters it is leaving to another setup.

- Test builds. New versions of the plugin can now be tried before everyone else gets them: players who opt in to the plugin's testing builds in Dalamud get them, and everyone else stays on the normal version. Each normal release is numbered above the last test build, so testers get it too. The download page says how to opt in.
- The app's PCs tab says how many characters each setup leaves to another one (with app 1.6.0).
- A reminder to set an account label. While a setup's Account Label is blank, the plugin's window and its settings say to give it one (for example, the account's name). Without one, the app can't tell your accounts apart, setups on one PC share a row on its PCs tab, and it can't spot two setups syncing the same character. App 1.6.0 points out characters and setups without a label too.
